description: This file defines the ThreadSnapshot class, representing a thread in a VM trace snapshot, including thread attributes, binder call info, and methods for copying and comparison.

classes.name: ThreadSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a thread in a VM trace snapshot, including thread state, binder call info, and stack frames.

methods.name: ThreadSnapshot
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: ThreadSnapshot
methods.description: Copy constructor for creating a deep copy of another ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of this ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this thread with another based on thread IDs.

methods.name: isBinder
methods.description: Returns true if the thread has an inbound or outbound binder call.
